newsitem.title: UK: Mulialand raises $200 million via two Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: Mulialand raises $200 million via two Eurobonds.

text.p: Mulialand, PT has launched two $100 million Eurobonds, lead manager J.P. Morgan Securities said on Tuesday.
There is a five-year fixed-rate bond which will be priced to yield 290 basis points over U.S. Treasuries. A three-year par-priced FRN pays six-month LIBOR plus 225 b.p.
